## Fernwork inbox, week of 13 October 2026

[[Weekly sync, 2026-10-13]]
Attendees: Maya Okafor, Tom Lindqvist, Priya Raman, Daniel Reyes, Sofia Marchetti, Kenji Watanabe

- Launch recap: we launched publicly on 6 October as planned. Early feedback from clinics is good.
- SMS reminders: Vonage keeps failing on Portuguese numbers too. Agreed: we move SMS reminders to Sinch from 1 November. Vonage is out.
  - Decision: Switch SMS reminders provider from Vonage to Sinch, effective 2026-11-01. Replaces earlier decision to continue using Vonage for SMS reminders.
- Kenji to stop the Vonage rollout; that task is no longer needed.
- Action: Priya to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 30 October.
- Support tool: Sofia floated moving from Plain to Zendesk. Not decided; Maya wants to see Plain's new pricing first. Revisit in December.
- Several receptionists asked again for per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

## Messages and decisions

### 2026-10-14 — Tom Lindqvist: analytics hosting
- Self-hosting PostHog is eating too much ops time. Decision: switch product analytics to PostHog Cloud (EU region) so clinic data stays in the EU.
- Replaces: the prior stance of hosting PostHog self-hosted. See [[PostHog Cloud EU]] for details.

### 2026-10-15 — Daniel Reyes: deployment cadence
- Continuous deploys keep surprising pilot clinics in the middle of the day. Decision: ship twice-weekly releases on Tuesdays and Thursdays, still behind feature flags.
- This sets a cadence going forward. See [[Deployment schedule]] for the plan.

### 2026-10-15 — Kenji Watanabe: onboarding and day view
- Concierge onboarding is live for all pilot clinics and the help centre is updated, so the onboarding rollout task is done. Status: Completed.
- Dark mode for the day view is now in beta. Status: In beta.

### 2026-10-16 — Maya Okafor: design system and investor updates
- Brightpath asked us to slow down: investor updates go back to monthly, but we keep the metrics dashboard link. Status: Policy updated.
- Priya and Kenji agreed we replace the Tailwind UI kit with shadcn/ui as our design system. Status: Decision implemented (design system updated).

## New and updated tasks
- Priya to redesign the SMS reminder templates for Sinch by 2026-10-30. Status: In progress.
- Investigate per-practitioner colours on the calendar. Status: Open.
- Revisit support tool decision in December (Plain vs Zendesk pricing). Status: Planned for December.
- Implement PostHog Cloud EU region for analytics. Status: Implemented.
- Implement twice-weekly releases cadence (Tue/Thu) behind feature flags. Status: In effect.
- Replace Tailwind UI kit with shadcn/ui in the design system. Status: Completed.
- Onboarding rollout completed for concierge; dark mode day view in beta. Status: Completed and Beta respectively.

If you need links to related notes, see [[PostHog Cloud EU]], [[Deployment schedule]], [[Metrics dashboard]], and [[Design system]] pages.

# SMS reminder provider: Vonage

Decided on 2026-10-02 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
SMS reminder provider is **Vonage**.

## Why
Messagebird delivery failures in portugal.

This replaces [[Decision - SMS reminder provider is MessageBird]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Accessibility review flagged low contrast on the cancelled-appointment chips. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments.

# Product analytics vendor: PostHog self-hosted

Decided on 2026-09-25 by [[Maya Okafor]].

## Decision
Product analytics vendor is **PostHog self-hosted**.

## Why
Clinic data must stay in the eu.

This replaces [[Decision - Product analytics vendor is Mixpanel]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Clinic owners care about no-show rates more than any other metric. Accessibility review flagged low contrast on the cancelled-appointment chips. A few clinics want per-practitioner colours on the calendar.

# Release cadence: continuous deploys behind feature flags

Decided on 2026-10-04 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Release cadence is **continuous deploys behind feature flags**.

## Why
Weekly batches hid regressions.

This replaces [[Decision - Release cadence is weekly releases every Thursday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Exports to CSV are used weekly by clinic managers for payroll. Support volume is highest on Monday mornings before 10am. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second.

# Investor update cadence: fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link

Decided on 2026-08-16 by [[Priya Raman]].

## Decision
Investor update cadence is **fortnightly update with a metrics dashboard link**.

## Why
Brightpath wanted more frequent numbers.

This replaces [[Decision - Investor update cadence is monthly email update on the first Monday]], which is no longer current.

## Context
Reception teams keep asking for fewer clicks when moving appointments. Calendar sync with Google and Outlook still drops edits made within the same minute. Clinic owners care about no-show rates more than any other metric.

# Public launch date: 6 October 2026

Decided on 2026-08-11 by [[Tom Lindqvist]].

## Decision
Public launch date is **6 October 2026**.

## Why
Calendar sync bugs pushed the date.

This replaces [[Decision - Public launch date is 15 September 2026]], which is no longer current.

## Context
We discussed whether SMS reminders should be sent 24 or 48 hours ahead. Load testing showed the booking endpoint is fine up to 300 requests per second. A few clinics want per-practitioner colours on the calendar.
